title: Dak helplines bundle v1
description: Official fraud / spam / emergency helplines shown on the Report fraud screen. The copy bundled in the app is trusted as is (signature null); an over-the-air copy must carry a base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON encoding of `payload` (same scheme as the template bundle) and a higher `revision`.

signature.description: Base64 signature over the canonical JSON of payload; null only for the copy bundled in the app.

revision.description: Monotonic; an update is applied only when its revision is higher than the one in use.

bankCardBlock.description: Bank card-block / fraud numbers. Empty until each number is verified against the bank's own website; users can add their own bank's number in the app (stored locally, shown as unverified).

action.description: call opens the dialer (never places the call), sms opens the composer, url opens the browser.

target.description: Phone number / short code for call and sms, https URL for url.

sourceUrl.description: Official page that publishes this helpline.

lastVerified.description: Date the entry was last checked against sourceUrl.

smsFormat.description: For action sms: body template. Placeholders {text}, {sender}, {date:<java date pattern>}.
